svg.text: SVT-AV1-PSY: rebuild an AV1 video encoder from its behavior
The agent can run the reference encoder but cannot read it. From its documentation and what it prints, it writes a new program from scratch that gives the same
output, exit codes and files, and the grader replays 453 recorded runs against it.
